entries.diagnostic: Assembly.GetEntryAssembly resolves to the closure/host instead of generated Celeste
entries.transformation: Use Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly for discovery owned by the Celeste library.
entries.behaviouralRationale: The modern Celeste assembly is a library loaded by a separate tvOS executable.
entries.stage3BTest: verify tracked/pooled type discovery, overworld Oui discovery and command registration before first frame

entries.diagnostic: Settings.XmlComment reconstruction is incompatible with the serializer path used by the legacy iOS pipeline
entries.transformation: Remove the informational XML comment-only property.
entries.behaviouralRationale: The property carries no settings state and existed only to emit explanatory text.
entries.stage3BTest: round-trip default Settings without the comment node in ignored temporary storage

entries.diagnostic: SYSLIB0011: BinaryFormatter is obsolete and disabled in modern .NET
entries.transformation: Throw PlatformNotSupportedException only for the Binary mode; retain XML mode.
entries.behaviouralRationale: No generated Celeste call site uses Monocle.SaveLoad, and unsafe binary serialization must not be silently re-enabled.
entries.stage3BTest: assert the Binary mode fails loudly and confirm no normal startup call site reaches it

entries.diagnostic: The decompiler emits a private executable Main method, but Stage 3A produces a library
entries.transformation: Rename it to public static Run(string[]) without invoking it.
entries.behaviouralRationale: Stage 3B needs a controlled non-reflected callable boundary; Stage 3A only roots it for AOT closure.
entries.stage3BTest: invoke Run only after the modern SDL lifecycle hands control to the managed host

entries.diagnostic: System.Security.Permissions is absent from the modern target
entries.transformation: Remove an unused using directive; retain the remaining assembly metadata.
entries.behaviouralRationale: No permission attribute is present or required.
entries.stage3BTest: verify Celeste assembly identity and reflected metadata

entries.diagnostic: IL3050/IL2026 on Type-based Enum and Marshal overloads with statically known types
entries.transformation: Use equivalent generic Enum.GetValues, Marshal.SizeOf and Marshal.PtrToStructure overloads.
entries.behaviouralRationale: The types are compile-time constants; generic overloads preserve behaviour and make AOT requirements explicit.
entries.stage3BTest: exercise area stats/journal construction; FMOD marshaling remains deferred to Stage 5

entries.diagnostic: Device AOT links rooted FMOD P/Invoke wrappers, but Stage 3A is prohibited from linking native FMOD
entries.transformation: Deterministically replace only generated FMOD extern declarations with managed PlatformNotSupportedException bodies and record every symbol.
entries.behaviouralRationale: This is an ignored, compile-only source boundary, not a native stub or audio implementation; any reached call fails loudly.
entries.stage3BTest: replace or deliberately bypass Audio.Init before runtime; restore exact FMOD 1.10.x native resolution only in Stage 5
